gm_lines: These are four separate Secret manuals. The GM confirms which manual you learned and resolves only that manual with its own cost, duration and use limit. This heading does not activate all four at once.

Secret Saber Manuals are rare battlefield lineages, executioner records, cavalry scriptures, frontier army inheritances, bandit-king scars, or named-blade teachings. They are powerful, but Sabers is not intended to have Lightning-style regional sovereignty by default.

Manual of the Red Gate Charge - Secret, Battleline: Action, Cost 3 CP. Move up to your Speed in a straight or gently curving line. During this movement, you may pass through spaces occupied by hostile creatures, but you cannot end there. Choose up to three creatures whose spaces you passed through or moved adjacent to. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: 4d8 slashing damage and knocked Prone if Large or smaller. Successful Save: Half damage and not Prone. Use Limit: Once per short or long rest. At Core Formation Realm, the damage increases to 6d8 and you may affect up to five creatures.

Execution Platform Sutra - Secret, Execution: Bonus Action, Duration 1 minute, Cost 5 CP, Use Limit Once per long rest. For the duration, the first time each turn you hit a Guard Pressured, Restrained, Prone, Stunned, Incapacitated, or Bloodied creature with a Sabers talent, choose one: add 3d8 slashing damage; suppress one non-Secret reaction, parry, guard, or defensive stance until the end of the target's next turn; force a Constitution saving throw; on failure, the target cannot regain HP or CP until the start of your next turn. This sutra does not kill helpless targets automatically. It makes execution mechanically possible under combat rules.

Black Banner Cavalry Dao - Secret, Pursuit, Battleline: Bonus Action, Duration 1 minute, Cost 5 CP, Use Limit Once per long rest. For the duration, when you move at least 20 feet on your turn, your next Sabers hit before the end of that turn deals +2d8 slashing damage and pushes the target 10 feet on a failed Strength save. Once during the duration, when a creature you damaged attempts to move farther away from you, you may use Red Trail Pursuit without spending your Reaction. If you are mounted, your mount also ignores nonmagical difficult terrain created by crowds, mud, grass, shallow water, snow, or loose battlefield debris for the duration. This manual does not grant Horse-Soul, mount intelligence, or warband command.

Tiger-Butcher Short Saber Manual - Secret, Cruel: When you hit a creature within 5 feet with a short saber, duan dao, or butterfly saber, you may spend 2 CP. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It takes 3d8 slashing damage and suffers one Saber Wound. Successful Save: It takes half damage and no Saber Wound. If the target is larger than you, Guard Pressured, or grappled by you or an ally, it has Disadvantage on the save. Use Limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest.

gm_lines: Choose yourself and up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures
the ability to know true north
the ability to estimate time until sunrise, sunset, moonrise, or local nightfall if such cycles exist
the ability to know the direction of the nearest active Star Anchor you created within 1 mile

Aligned Benefit: Beneath Open Sky or within 30 feet of a Star Anchor, the creatures may also estimate approximate latitude, identify major known landmarks by direction, and notice whether the sky is supernaturally distorted
Time: 30 days
Cost: 15 CP and 25,000 gp in crystal, star-metal, jade, mirrors, lenses, astronomical instruments, and observatory construction

Create a permanent celestial observatory. Choose three benefits: Star Anchors last indefinitely within 10 miles of the observatory; Stars talents cost 1 fewer CP once per turn nearby, minimum 1; Divination, Space, Formations, and Stars projects gain +2 on relevant checks made through the observatory; celestial disturbances become easier to notice; long-distance navigation improves dramatically for designated sect members; Constellation Road may connect permanent anchors maintained by the observatory; one observatory chamber reveals supernatural distortion in the night sky; Star Maps created inside update automatically; warning constellations appear when major threats approach the observatory's territory; students studying Stars gain +2 on one relevant training check
You may maintain a number of Celestial Observatories equal to your Proficiency Bonus unless the campaign treats them as sect infrastructure instead of personal projects
